title: Liquid Emotions: Amulet Instilling, Combinations and Current Restrictions
summary: Distilled Emotions anoint a Notable passive onto your Amulet without spending skill points; Waystones can no longer be instilled with Liquid Emotions. This guide covers the current anointing flow, combination lookup, re-anointing, and the historical Waystone restriction.
description: A source-linked reference for Distilled Emotions / Liquid Emotions in Path of Exile 2: current Amulet anointing, the 10 emotion types, combination lookup, and the Waystone instilling restriction introduced in 0.4.0.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Distilled Emotion currency item icon from Path of Exile 2 - a vial of emotion used to anoint Amulets with Notable passives

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.callout: Right-click a Distilled Emotion to open the Instilling window, place your Amulet in the top slot and three Emotions in the bottom slots (order matters), then Instill. You get the Notable passive shown, without spending tree points. Re-anointing overwrites the old enchantment.
calloutDetail: Hold Alt on a Notable in the passive tree to see its exact 3-Emotion combination.
Waystones could be instilled in older versions, but the 0.4.0 content update removed that option. Current Liquid Emotion anoints are for Amulets.

answers.label: Use for
text: A Notable far from your tree path without spending the corresponding passive point.

answers.label: Check first
text: Do not anoint a Notable you already allocated on the tree - it will not stack.

answers.label: Avoid
text: Trusting old videos that show Waystone instilling or a different anointing menu.

facts.label: Types
note: Despair, Disgust, Greed, Ire, Suffering, Paranoia, Guilt, Envy, Fear, Isolation.

facts.label: Source
note: Drop from Delirium maps, Simulacrum, and the Currency Exchange.

facts.label: Target
note: Amulet = Notable passive; Waystone instilling was removed in 0.4.0.

facts.label: Order
note: The combination and its order decide the result.

sections.title: The ten emotions
intro: Each Distilled Emotion maps to a group of passives. The three you combine, in order, pick the outcome for an Amulet Notable.

members.title: Distilled Ire
body: In Amulet combinations it leans toward aggressive or defensive stats (for example High Alert and Parrying Motion).

members.title: Distilled Fear
body: In Amulet combinations it appears in crit-focused passives such as Stormcharged.

members.title: Distilled Envy
body: In Amulet combinations it appears in flask-focused passives such as Heavy Drinker.

members.title: Distilled Greed
body: In Amulet combinations it pairs with Ire for evasion-focused passives such as High Alert.

members.title: Distilled Despair
body: In Amulet combinations it appears in attack-speed passives such as Deep Trance.

members.title: Disgust / Suffering / Paranoia / Guilt / Isolation
body: Each completes specific Notable combinations. Check the in-game Alt preview for the exact set.

sections.title: How to get Distilled Emotions
intro: Emotions come almost entirely from Delirium content.

routes.label: Delirium maps
body: Run maps with the Delirium modifier; each reward guarantees at least one Distilled Emotion, scaling with how long you stay in the fog.

routes.label: Simulacrum
body: Endgame wave content that drops Emotions and splinters.

routes.label: Reforging Bench
body: Combine three of the same lower-tier Emotion into a higher tier.

routes.label: Currency Exchange / trade
body: Buy the specific Emotions you need from other players.

steps.label: Find the Notable
body: Open the passive tree, hold Alt on a Notable to see its required 3-Emotion combination and order.

steps.label: Open Instilling
body: Right-click any Distilled Emotion to open the Instilling / Decanter window.

steps.label: Place items
body: Put the Amulet in the top slot, the three Emotions in the bottom slots left to right.

steps.label: Instill
body: Confirm the named passive, then Instill. The result is an item implicit on the Amulet.

sections.title: What you can anoint
note: Amulets take a Notable passive. Waystones can no longer be instilled with Liquid Emotions after the 0.4.0 content update, and rings or other gear are not valid targets.

items.label: Notable not already allocated
checks: Confirm the Notable is not on your passive tree path.
items.why: Anointing does not stack with the tree node.
items.fix: Pick a Notable outside your path.

items.label: Right combination and order
checks: Alt-preview the Notable; match the three Emotions left to right.
items.why: Wrong order gives a different (or unwanted) result.

items.label: Amulet is the one you keep
checks: The enchantment is permanent until re-anointed.

sections.title: Which builds anoint what
intro: Anointing shines when a Notable sits far from your route. Match the Notable to your damage and defence plan.

builds.title: Crit elemental
builds.description: Stormcharged (Fear/Fear/Envy) for +crit elemental damage after a crit.

builds.title: Evasion / tanky
builds.description: High Alert (Ire/Ire/Greed) for evasion and stun threshold at full HP.

builds.title: Block builds
builds.description: Parrying Motion (Ire/Fear/Ire) for block chance and move speed.

builds.title: Flask / sustain
builds.description: Heavy Drinker (Envy/Envy/Envy) for flask effect and life recovery.

entries.question: I anointed a Notable I already have on the tree - did it stack?
summary: A player anointed a Notable they had allocated, expecting double value.
editorialAnalysis: Anointing grants the Notable as an item implicit; it does not stack with the same tree node. The anoint was wasted.
officialAnswer: Only anoint Notables you have NOT allocated on the tree.

entries.question: Why do old videos show Waystone instilling differently?
summary: Players followed outdated guides describing a separate old system.
editorialAnalysis: Waystone instilling was removed in the 0.4.0 content update; current Liquid Emotion anoints target Amulets only.
officialAnswer: Use the current in-game Instilling window; ignore old Waystone-only guides.
